name: kubernetes-manager
description: Codex workflow support for Kubernetes project integration, workload operations, and managed cluster administration.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate projects, operate workloads, and administer Kubernetes clusters.
interface.longDescription: Adds a Codex skill and helper scripts for assessing a project, generating Kubernetes manifests, checking Docker Desktop Kubernetes, connecting to OKE or Azure AKS clusters, administering cluster resources and node pools, validating resources, and applying workloads through kubectl.
defaultPrompt: Use Kubernetes Manager to integrate this project with Kubernetes.
Check whether Docker Desktop Kubernetes is ready for local development.
Generate Kubernetes manifests for this service and validate them.
Connect kubectl to OKE or Azure AKS and deploy this project.
Create a Kubernetes cluster report and inspect failing workloads.
Scale a deployment or managed node pool.
